hook: Penguins are hiding knees under feathers

scenes.line: You think their legs start basically at their belly. Wrong.
scenes.visual_prompt: A sleek penguin waddling across ice, viewed from the side in bright Antarctic sunlight, its body profile emphasized against white snow

scenes.line: Under all those feathers? A full thigh bone and knee
scenes.visual_prompt: A translucent anatomical overlay showing a penguin's skeleton in profile: visible femur, knee joint, and tibia glowing softly in blue against a dark background

scenes.line: They're literally walking around with folded legs the whole time.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up slow-motion of a penguin's side profile waddling, feathers ruffling to subtly suggest movement in the upper leg area beneath the surface

scenes.line: That's why they can dive so explosively and swim insanely
scenes.visual_prompt: A penguin launching off an ice edge into dark blue-green ocean water, body fully extended mid-dive, water droplets frozen in mid-air catching light

cta: If penguins have hidden knees, what other animal anatomy would shock you if you knew the truth?
